sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:174178
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 39014 of 2024
Applicant :- Leelawati Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Dhirendra Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri D.K. Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned Aga for
the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime
No. 109 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Khiri,
District Prayagraj during pendency of the trial.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present matter along with father-in-law and Devar of the deceased.
4. He further submits that actually marriage of the deceased was solemnized with the son of the applicant about four months before and immediately after marriage her husband had gone to State of Haryana for his livelihood and deceased always insisted to live with him in Haryana but due to bad financial condition her husband was not able to live with her in State of Haryana and only due Leelawati Devi vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143464944/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: to this reason within four months of her marriage in anger she committed suicide by hanging herself.

5. He further submits, however, from perusal of the post mortem report it reflects, apart from the ligature mark deceased also sustained multiple abrasion 05cm x 02cm on mid part of upper chest but it appears, when deceased was trying to hang herself then she sustained these abrasions.
He further submits even as per autopsy surgeon deceased died due to hanging, therefore, prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death.

6. He further submits that on the basis of general allegation applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with her husband and another son and she is lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 17.06.2024.
7.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and her daughter-in-law died within four months of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and it is a peculiar case, in which, husband of the deceased has not been made accused and this fact shows that for the abnormal death of the deceased, applicant and other two co-accused, who were named in the FIR, were responsible but could not dispute the fact there is no specific allegation against the applicant and deceased died due to hanging and in paragraph no.18 applicant has taken a specific defence that deceased always insisted to live with her husband in the State of Haryana and only due to this reason she hanged herself.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, it reflects that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within four months of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and there is no allegation against the husband of the deceased but applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.
10.

Further, from the perusal of the FIR, it reflects that deceased died due to hanging, therefore,
prima facie it appears to be a case of suicidal death and, therefore, defence taken by the applicant for the alleged suicide committed by the deceased in the instant bail application cannot be ruled out at this stage.
11.
Further, applicant is a lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 17.06.2024.

12. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

sentences.text:
Let the applicant - Leelawati Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
